> 第279章 新途（第1页）
新世界第三年春，秦川背起行囊，沿着千峰山脉南麓的商道往东走。苏木槿骑着她那匹青骢马跟在他旁边，马背上驮着两箱凡人医学堂新编的教材。
他们此行目的地是中界东部——一个从未被任何宗门覆盖过的偏远区域，蛛网去年在那里设了第一个流动诊所，如今已发展为三间固定站点。
沿途经过三石镇时，鲁铁匠的孙女正在诊所门口晒药材。她认得秦川的脚步声，头也没回就说药库昨天新到了一批烫伤膏，冰片含量比老配方又降了一点，镇痛效果没降。
苏木槿下马帮她把晒药的竹匾翻了个面，告诉她沈青黛那边试了半年得出的新配比，正在修订第三版凡人医药手册，快印好了。
穿过驼岭镇时，钱庄分号的伙计正在往新一批药材直供线上贴封条——第三批直供线已覆盖中界东部，首批药材正在装车。
钱不缺在柜台后面低头写调度单，看到秦川进来只是扬了扬手算作招呼，继续埋头工作。
途经登天城，废渠入口已被改建成正式的物资中转站。城门口那个秦川在仓库重建时帮忙搬砖瓦的物资仓库已重新启用，门楣上钉着一块木牌，上面是蛛网的标记，旁边刻着赵伯那句
“千秋万岁，都不会灭”。最后一站是当年他第一次踏入中界时走过的临渊镇。
镇口那间青山堂铺子已扩建为双开间，坐诊的是药童那个现在已经能独立开方的外派师弟。
铺子门口排着十几个来复诊的凡人，老榕树的树冠将整个院子罩在浓荫里。
秦川没有进去打扰，和苏木槿在镇口茶摊喝了两碗茶，然后沿着当初苏木槿第一次带他进百草谷时走的瀑布小径往回走。
瀑布还在，水声依旧。秦川在瀑布下面的青石上坐下，苏木槿将马蹄系在树上，在他旁边坐下。

> Chapter 279 New Path (Page 1)
In the spring of the third year of the New World, Qin Chuan packed up his luggage and walked east along the trade road at the southern foot of the Qianfeng Mountains. Su Muxin followed him on her green horse, carrying two boxes of newly compiled textbooks from the Mortal Medicine Hall on the horse's back.
The destination of their trip was the eastern part of the Central Realm - a remote area that has never been covered by any sect. Spider Web set up its first mobile clinic there last year and has now developed into three fixed sites.
While passing through Sanshi Town along the way, Blacksmith Lu's granddaughter was drying medicinal materials in front of the clinic. She recognized Qin Chuan's footsteps, and without looking back, she said that a new batch of burn ointment had arrived at the medicine store yesterday. The borneol content was slightly lower than the old formula, but the analgesic effect was not reduced.
Su Muxin got off his horse and helped her turn over the bamboo plaque on which the medicine was dried, and told her that Shen Qingdai had tried the new ratio for half a year and was revising the third edition of the Mortal Medicine Manual, which would be printed soon.
When passing through Tuoling Town, the clerk at the Qianzhuang Branch was affixing seals to a new batch of direct supply lines for medicinal materials - the third batch of direct supply lines had covered the eastern part of the border, and the first batch of medicinal materials were being loaded onto trucks.
Qian Buque was writing a dispatch form with his head down behind the counter. When he saw Qin Chuan coming in, he just raised his hand as a greeting and continued to work hard.
Passing through Dengtian City, the entrance to the waste canal has been transformed into a formal material transfer station. The material warehouse at the gate of the city where Qin Chuan helped move bricks and tiles during the reconstruction of the warehouse has been reused. There is a wooden sign nailed to the lintel with the symbol of a spider web on it, and Uncle Zhao's words are engraved next to it.
"Even if it lasts forever, it will never be destroyed." The last stop was Linyuan Town, which he walked through when he first entered the middle world.
The Qingshan Tang shop at the entrance of the town has been expanded into a double room, and the one who is doing the consultation is the medicine boy, who is now able to prescribe independently.
A dozen people who came for follow-up consultations were lined up at the door of the shop, and the canopy of the old banyan tree cast a deep shade over the entire yard.
Qin Chuan did not go in to disturb him, and drank two bowls of tea with Su Muzhen at the tea stall at the entrance of the town, and then walked back along the waterfall path that Su Muzhen took when he first took him into Baicao Valley.
The waterfall is still there and the sound of water is still there. Qin Chuan sat down on the bluestone under the waterfall, and Su Mujin tied the horse's hoof to the tree and sat down next to him.
